question: 가장 많은 배우가 출연한 영화의 제목은?
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY f.title ORDER BY COUNT(fa.actor_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
label: Lambs Cincinatti
infer_sql:
SELECT f.title
FROM film f
JOIN (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(actor_id) AS actor_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY film_id
) fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id
WHERE fa.actor_count = (
  SELECT MAX(actor_count) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(actor_id) AS actor_count
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
  ) sub
);

question: 가장 많이 대여된 영화의 제목은?
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY f.title ORDER BY COUNT(r.rental_id) DESC LIMIT 1;

infer_sql:
SELECT f.title
FROM film f
JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM film f2
    JOIN inventory i2 ON i2.film_id = f2.film_id

  ) s
);

question: 평균 길이가 가장 짧은 카테고리는?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY AVG(f.length) ASC LIMIT 1;
label: Sci-Fi
infer_sql:
SELECT c.category_id, c.name, AVG(f.length) AS avg_length
FROM category c
JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
WHERE f.length IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
HAVING AVG(f.length) = (
  SELECT MIN(avg_len) FROM (
    SELECT AVG(f2.length) AS avg_len
    FROM category c2
    JOIN film_category fc2 ON fc2.category_id = c2.category_id
    JOIN film f2 ON f2.film_id = fc2.film_id
    WHERE f2.length IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c2.category_id
  ) sub
);
